correctness.rationale: For every q>0, E>=12q², and D>0, primitive reduction yields ∥qf+F∥² on clamped H0² with ∥F''∥²=E-12q². Explicit Gk solves the stationary ODE. Beam spectrum and odd forcing show the stationary excess energy increases strictly to a finite critical value; exact equal-energy quadratic identity and sharp simple clamped eigenvalue give unique global optimum below/at and exactly two above. The critical constants, normalization, parity, supercritical linear law and physical D coefficient are verified independently by analytic quadrature and polynomial Galerkin checks. Finite checks are not proofs of infinite-dimensional statements.

value.rationale: The throughflow-versus-dissipation constrained enhancement of long-time scalar spreading is a natural transport design question. The complete sharp transition at 3.085% above minimum dissipation, explicit optimal flows, onset ∝sqrt(E-Ec), and exact linear high-budget law distinguish a symmetric transport mode from reflected optimal backflow patterns. This is a motivated infinite-dimensional physical profile classification, beyond numeric reoptimization of one flow. It does not assert feasibility under uniform pressure gradient or nonnegative velocity.
